title: crypto2dev AES-CBC KAT fails: IV not copied when SETKEY intercepts wc_AesSetKey
description: In crypto2dev_port.c, when WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_SETKEY is active, the WC_SETKEY_AES callback returns 0 (handled), causing wolfSSL to exit wc_AesSetKey without running the software path that copies the IV into aes->reg. As a result, aes->reg is all-zeros when crypto2dev_cipher reads it for CBC mode. The cipher sends wrong IV to hardware, producing wrong ciphertext. Fix: in the WC_SETKEY_AES case, copy the IV from info->setKey.iv (if available) to aes->reg before returning, OR store IV in devCtx.
